{{Quote|A Jedi holocron is an important artifact, and it must not fall into the wrong hands.|A New Republic commander|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
'''Kaerobani's holocron''' was a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi holocron/Legends|holocron]] stolen by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Kaerobani]] from a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] using an [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor cruiser]]. His crew sorted through the pillaged goods aboard the [[Orbiting Ship Yards]] before sending the holocron in a sealed crate to [[Kaerobani's base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rathalay]] to add it to his collection of rare artifacts.<ref name="MOTS" />

Alongside other trophies, Kaerobani displayed the holocron on a dais at the end of a long hallway, emphasizing the rare artifact. Its time in Kaerobani's museum was short, however. The holocron was recovered by New Republic agent and Jedi [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] who infiltrated the base,<ref name="MOTS" /> retrieving the stolen holocron before the pirate could unlock its mysteries.<ref name="CWSE">{{CSWECite|II|191|Kaerobani}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The dread pirate Kaerobani (and that's me being clever with the word Caribbean) steals a Sith holocron and Mara has to chase him to his hideout.|Ryan Kaufman|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
The holocron appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' in the loading screen artwork and the game itself.<ref name="MOTS" /> Level designer [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] misidentified the holocron as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] holocron in his retrospective blog post.<ref name="Blog" /> The reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' also continues this error while adding the additional element of Kaerobani stealing it from a facility on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CWSE" />
